about: Hand-written meaning of each sticker. scripts/build_stickers.py cleans originals/ → public/stickers/ and adds measured fields (aspect, palette) into public/stickers/library.json. Edit THIS file, then rebuild.

fields.kind: botanical | food | object | weather | creature | accent | figure
fields.medium: how it was made; photographic cut-outs compete with the author's real photos, so the picker allows at most one
fields.generic: true = decoration that may appear on colour fit alone; false = a specific thing that needs a content match (no eggs benedict on a day without brunch)
fields.tags: content words matched against the story. For generic:false stickers keep ONLY words that name the thing itself (never broad words like street, cafe, city) — one loose tag is enough to pull a specific object onto an unrelated day
fields.moods: feeling words matched against Moment moods
fields.role: accent (small, 80–160 px) | corner (anchors a page corner, 180–320 px) | hero (can hold a large empty area)

stickers.label: Yellow umbrella
stickers.notes: Soft watercolor; reads well tilted near a rainy photo.

stickers.label: Soft cloud
stickers.notes: Blue-cream; pair with pencil rain strokes under it.

stickers.label: Sage butterfly
stickers.notes: Fine engraved lines with a pink rim; keep small.

stickers.label: Pink rose
stickers.notes: Saturated magenta; only when pink/red already lives in the photos.

stickers.label: Ginkgo leaf
stickers.notes: Green with yellow edges; strong autumn signal.

stickers.label: Collage apple
stickers.notes: Torn-paper red with newsprint; matches the tape-collage language.

stickers.label: Cherries
stickers.notes: Glossy photo with a white paper cut border; photographic.

stickers.label: Lime
stickers.notes: Bright green; loud against muted palettes.

stickers.label: Green tree
stickers.notes: Photographic and dense; use at most one, small, near a green photo.

stickers.label: Statue face
stickers.notes: Black ink on transparency: only on light paper. Faces carry meaning; never beside a real person's face.

stickers.label: Pressed wildflowers
stickers.notes: Faded beige, lavender; blends into almost any muted palette.

stickers.label: Vintage bicycle
stickers.notes: Brown ink tones; only when someone rode or saw bikes.

stickers.label: Cardboard stars
stickers.notes: Mustard yellow; use as a small cheer mark, never more than one cluster.

backgrounds.label: Wildflower watercolor wash
backgrounds.notes: Full-bleed watercolor paper with lavender and sage wildflowers at the lower right; leaves the upper left empty for a title. Use as a low-opacity page wash for gentle nature days, not as a sticker. Not tileable.
